title: Emotion Mirror: Face-Driven Avatar Puppeteering
description: A ReadyPlayer.Me avatar stands on a circular stage facing a floating magical mirror that displays the facecap head. The user selects from 6 emotion presets (joy, anger, sadness, surprise, disgust, neutral) via on-screen buttons, which drive the facecap morph targets in the mirror. Clicking a 'Transfer' button blends the current facial expression onto the avatar's face, building a recorded emotion sequence that can be played back as a looping animation timeline.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with three and three/addons from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0). Load both shared_assets/facecap.glb and shared_assets/readyplayer.me.glb using GLTFLoader. Scene setup: dark gradient background (#1a1a2e to #16213e). Place the ReadyPlayer.Me avatar at center (0,0,0) scaled to roughly 1.7m tall. Position a decorative circular mirror frame (gold torus geometry) floating at (-2, 1.5, 0) angled 20 degrees toward the avatar. Mount the facecap head inside the mirror frame at matching position and scale. Add three-point lighting: warm key light, cool fill light, and subtle rim light. Camera at (0, 1.5, 3.5) looking at avatar chest height with OrbitControls limited to 45-degree horizontal arc. Create an HTML overlay panel with 6 emotion buttons (Joy, Anger, Sadness, Surprise, Disgust, Neutral) each with a distinct emoji icon and color. When an emotion button is clicked: (1) validate the facecap model has morph targets, (2) smoothly animate 3-5 relevant morph target influences on the facecap head over 500ms using lerp (e.g., Joy drives mouthSmile + eyeSquint + cheekPuff; Anger drives browDown + mouthFrown + jawOpen slightly; Surprise drives eyeWide + browUp + jawOpen + mouthOpen). Add a 'Transfer to Avatar' button that copies the current facecap morph target values onto matching morph targets of the ReadyPlayer.Me avatar head mesh with a 700ms animated blend, accompanied by a particle burst effect between mirror and avatar. Implement a timeline bar at the bottom that records each transferred emotion as a colored keyframe block. After recording at least 3 keyframes, enable a 'Play Sequence' button that loops through recorded emotions on the avatar at 1.5s intervals. Add a 'Clear Timeline' button to reset. Validate that users must select an emotion before transferring, and must transfer before playing. Show toast notifications for validation errors. Track interaction count and display it.
